programme.title: Love Comes Softly
programme.desc: Marty is a 19 year old pioneer woman, recently married. She goes west with her husband Clem, hoping to start a new life. But Clem unexpectedly dies, and Marty finds herself alone, two months pregnant. Clark Davis, a widower, offers her a marriage of convenience: she needs food and money, and he needs someone to take care of his daughter Missie. She accepts his proposal as a temporary solution.

programme.title: Ladies of the House
programme.desc: Three women find solace in each other's company while rebuilding a home for their church's day-care program. The construction process proves therapeutic as they navigate their tumultuous personal lives.

programme.title: The Wishing Tree
programme.desc: An attorney (Alfre Woodard) returns to her native Georgia when her storyteller mother dies, and becomes involved in the case of a "magic man" accused of a crime. Thomas: Blair Underwood. Professor: Leslie Carlson. Wallis: Helen Shaver. Jamie: Stephen Joffe. Alexa: Kaleigh Nevin. Mattie: Mary Alice.

programme.title: Love's Abiding Joy
programme.desc: In this drama based on the fourth book in Janette Oke's best-selling "Love Comes Softly" series, Missie and Willie LaHaye (Erin Cottrell, Logan Bartholomew) get accustomed to rugged frontier life, but tragedy threatens to shake up their stable family. Michael Landon Jr. directed.

programme.title: Honeymoon for One
programme.desc: A Los Angeles advertising exec travels to Ireland alone for her honeymoon after breaking things off with her dishonest fiancé. While abroad, she develops a connection with a local estate manager, but a conflict involving the woman's business threatens the budding romance.

programme.title: Chasing Leprechauns
programme.desc: Michael Garrett, a New York corporate troubleshooter, is sent to a small town in Ireland to close a deal on a construction site believed to be inhabited by leprechauns. Michael sets out to get the approval of the town's leprechaun expert, Sarah Cavanaugh, and soon finds that is easier said than done.

programme.title: The Wedding Do Over
programme.desc: Wedding planner Abby specializes in fixing weddings that went wrong, but when she is forced to work with her ex-fiancé, she begins to question whether their relationship was the disaster she remembers.

programme.title: Elevator Girl
programme.desc: An uptight lawyer (Ryan Merriman) and a free-spirited woman (Lacey Chabert) become trapped in an elevator together. The incident produces sparks between the two, but their different lifestyles threaten to ruin the romance before it gets off the ground. Patty McCormack, Hedy Burress and Jonathan Bennett also star. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.title: Bad Date Chronicles
programme.desc: Leigh runs the popular website 'Bad Date Chronicles' where daters can go to anonymously post horrible date experiences. When rival blogger Conner becomes the subject of one of her posts, they agree to date each other in order to prove which one is actually a bad dater.

programme.title: Mary, Mother of Jesus
programme.desc: The story of the Madonna, from the virgin birth of her child to his Crucifixion and Resurrection.

programme.title: A Moving Romance
programme.desc: Emily inherits her family's moving company and butts heads with manager Scott, who thought he was being groomed to take over.

programme.title: Touched
programme.desc: A young nurse who takes a job as a live-in caretaker for a cantankerous, dying novelist discovers the secret of why the elderly woman is estranged from her son, and sets out to do something about it.

programme.title: Sisters of the Groom
programme.desc: Jason ropes his neighbor Sarah into pretending to be his girlfriend for his brother's wedding but his prying sisters suspect something is amiss.

programme.title: Mom and Dad Undergrads
programme.desc: Parents enroll in college to be closer to their kids, though they have vastly different reasons for doing so.

programme.title: The Joneses Unplugged
programme.desc: Newlyweds who are struggling with their relationship reconnect during a blackout, when their electronic devices are not working.

Now, caught between the excitement of the new adventure and the pain of not knowing when she'll see her family again, Missie copes with the challenges, and cherishes the rewards, of her new homestead.

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: A troubled young mother pins her hopes on winning an equestrian event after her husband leaves her to raise their daughter alone.

programme.title: Romantically Speaking
programme.desc: A relationship expert's public love life goes on the rocks, so her best male friend steps in to help keep up appearances, and their relationship takes an interesting turn.

programme.title: You've Got a Friend
programme.desc: Dylan McLaughlin plays Bobby, a boy who recently lost his parents and finds solace in box-car racing with help from the town loner (John Schneider), a former derby racer himself. But victory doesn't come easy for Bobby as he is forced to confront a bully and disapproval from his uncle (Jason Brooks). Miss Nelson: Bitty Schram.

programme.title: Love Comes Softly
programme.desc: Marty is a 19 year old pioneer woman, recently married. She goes west with her husband Clem, hoping to start a new life. But Clem unexpectedly dies, and Marty finds herself alone, two months pregnant. Clark Davis, a widower, offers her a marriage of convenience: she needs food and money, and he needs someone to take care of his daughter Missie. She accepts his proposal as a temporary solution.

programme.title: Always a Bride
programme.desc: A woman lets loose during her bachelorette party in Las Vegas and wakes up married to a movie star, much to her fiancé's chagrin. Delays with an annulment further complicate matters, and the woman is left questioning which man is truly right for her.

programme.title: Mulligan
programme.desc: A kids-show actor (Ethan Erickson) and a single mom (Jennie Garth) butt heads after the two are in a car accident. programme.desc: In this romantic tearjerker, an angst-ridden doctor (Lisa Hartman Black) returns home to attend a high-school reunion---and to mend fences with loved ones she left behind. Helen: Rue McClanahan. Gus: Dale Midkiff. Nelson: Larry Manetti.

programme.title: Time Capsule
programme.desc: After 10 years, a group of high school friends reunite at their alma mater's field house to dig up their time capsule. When they open the time capsule they decide to relive their fun high school moments which inspire a newfound relationship.

programme.title: Legally Tender
programme.desc: A new homeowner learns that her property is where the first Thanksgiving took place, and then she must fight to keep her house because a historian wants to raze it in order to study the historic site.

programme.title: Home Fires Burning
programme.desc: Slice of Americana about the impact of WWII on a Southern hamlet. Barnard Hughes. Pastine: Sada Thompson. Rosh: Robert Prosky. Henry: Bill Pullman. Francine: Elizabeth Berridge. Lonnie: Neil Patrick Harris. Billy: Kyle Chandler. Hilton: Wallace Wilkinson. Filmed in Georgia. Adapted by Robert Inman from his novel. Directed by Glenn Jordan.

programme.title: Vickery's Wild Ride
programme.desc: A successful ad man (Jonathan Silverman) tries to reconnect with his family by taking them on a monthlong vacation to a rustic cabin that he recently inherited. Though resistant at first, the family start to enjoy themselves after meeting a cowboy (Peter Strauss) who teaches them about life's simpler pleasures.

programme.title: Love's Unfolding Dream
programme.desc: The sixth installment of the "Love Comes Softly" series follows the now-grown Belinda Tyler (Scout Taylor-Compton) as she struggles to choose between her career aspirations as a doctor and her feelings for a New York lawyer who wants a traditional wife. Clark: Dale Midkiff. Missie: Erin Cottrell.

programme.title: Friend Request
programme.desc: A woman seeking romance finds an ideal man online, but she gets a surprise when she meets him and learns that his young son was posing as his dad and communicating with her.

programme.title: Mystery Girl
programme.desc: A man (Sean Patrick Flanery) sends secret-admirer e-mails to his crush (Christine Scott Bennett), but an e-mail-address mix-up causes the notes to go to the woman's lovelorn coworker (Brigid Brannagh) instead. And though the man and his crush start dating, he can't help but feel a connection with the woman he'd been e-mailing. Directed by Allison Anders.

programme.title: Midas
programme.desc: After a charismatic college dropout lies his way into a job at an insurance juggernaut, he recruits his two best friends for a plot to steal thousands. In the process, they uncover a much darker scheme that tests the limits of their greed.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

programme.title: The Men Who Stare at Goats
programme.desc: A struggling reporter (Ewan McGregor) gets the scoop of a lifetime when he meets a soldier (George Clooney) who claims to be part of a paranormal military unit that has been reactivated for duty in Iraq.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
programme.desc: When a single mother and her two children move to a new town, they soon discover they have a connection to the original Ghostbusters and the secret legacy their grandfather left behind.

programme.title: When the Bough Breaks
